# Zavient

> Independent AI consulting for companies of 40 to 500 people, across every kind of work and industry. Focus: AI that augments teams rather than replacing staff. Every market claim is sourced and footnoted.

Contact: hello@zavient.com | Free 30-minute diagnostic: https://zavient.com/#diagnostic

## Core pages

- [About Zavient: who we are and how we work](https://zavient.com/about.html): Who runs Zavient, how an engagement works and what it costs, and how we source and check every number on this site.
- [AI at work: guides, industry hubs and free tools](https://zavient.com/ai-work.html): Filter 61 researched AI guides, industry hubs, software comparisons and free interactive tools for companies of 40 to 500 people.
- [AI for every kind of work: where should your company start?](https://zavient.com/): Zavient helps companies of 40 to 500 people put AI to work in any function and any industry. Pick your kind of work or industry, try a free tool, or book a free 30-minute diagnostic.
- [Privacy policy](https://zavient.com/privacy.html): How Zavient LLC handles information on zavient.com. Interactive tools run in your browser with no signup and no ad tracking.

## Free interactive tools

- [AI agent cost estimator: what will an AI agent cost to run?](https://zavient.com/tools/ai-project-cost-estimator.html): Price one AI agent for one workflow: set-up, monthly fees, your team's review time and a first-year total, low to high, every default sourced.
- [AI implementation roadmap: what should we do first, and when?](https://zavient.com/tools/ai-roadmap-builder.html): Answer nine quick questions. Get a dated AI plan for a 40 to 500 person firm: groundwork, up to 3 projects, owners, review steps and checkpoints.
- [AI ROI calculator: will this workflow pay back this year?](https://zavient.com/tools/ai-roi-calculator.html): Pick one workflow and see the payback month, hours moved to better work and an honest low-to-high range. Sourced defaults, no email needed.
- [AI training for employees: how many hours, and who goes first?](https://zavient.com/tools/ai-training-plan.html): Enter your team sizes. Get a 90-day AI training plan: hours per person, cost of staff time and how many champions. No email needed.
